title: PaLM-style z-loss lambda=1e-4
mechanism: L = L_ce + 1e-4 * (log Sum exp logit)^2; grad += 2*lambda*z*softmax

title: WSD: warmup-stable-decay (tail 20% linear)
mechanism: lr = base_lr in stable phase warmup..0.8*post; linear decay base_lr->min_lr in last 20%

title: Disable weight decay on token embeddings
mechanism: AdamW apply_wd flipped false on w_tok in CPU + GPU optimizer wiring

title: Fixup-style zero-init of MHA + FFN output projections
mechanism: w_o and w_proj initialized to zero (via new_scaled with scale=0) instead of GPT-3 1/sqrt(2N) residual scaling

title: Focal cross-entropy (gamma=2)
mechanism: L = (1-p_t)^2 * (-log p_t); grad = standard_CE_grad * s where s = -dL/dp_t * p_t

title: Zero-init position embeddings
mechanism: w_pos = zeros instead of uniform[-0.02*sqrt(3), 0.02*sqrt(3)]; position bias learned from zero, causal mask provides order info

title: Composite: fixup + pos-embed zero-init

reason: transformer_smoke::cpu_transformer_converges_on_copy_task failed - 22% relative loss drop in 200 steps, test threshold requires 30%. Math correct, warm-up too slow for smoke window.

title: He/Kaiming-uniform init for LinearProj

reason: transformer_primitives::mha_causal_backward_matches_numerical failed - rel err 0.083 vs TOL 0.050. Sharper softmax at d_model=8 exceeds central-difference precision. Math correct, test tolerance too tight for this init regime.

title: Logit temperature T=2 before softmax in CE
mechanism: L = -log softmax(2*logit)[target]; grad = 2*(softmax(2*logit) - 1_target). Effective 2x LR through LM head pathway.

title: Composite: fixup zero-init + WSD schedule
mechanism: w_o = w_proj = 0 (fixup) AND cosine_warmup body replaced with WSD (warmup -> stable base_lr -> linear decay tail 20%)

title: AdamW eps default 1e-8 to 1e-6
mechanism: AdamWConfig default eps changed; floors denominator in update step. Effect mainly on parameters with very small squared-grad EMA.

title: LayerNorm eps 1e-5 to 1e-3
mechanism: All LayerNorm eps changed from 1e-5 to 1e-3 (CPU + 8 GPU dispatch sites). Looser variance floor in normalization denominator.

title: Composite: fixup + WSD + pos-embed at 1/4 magnitude
mechanism: w_o = w_proj = 0 (fixup) AND w_pos at 1/4 baseline magnitude (uniform[+-0.0087]); WSD schedule was intended but file write was blocked.
reason: transformer_smoke::cpu_transformer_converges_on_copy_task failed - 28% relative drop vs 30% threshold. Combination of fixup + quarter-pos still slowed warmup below smoke barrier.

title: Attention scale x 2/3 (softer)
mechanism: scaled_dot_product attention scale = (2/3)/sqrt(d_k) instead of 1/sqrt(d_k), in CPU + 4 GPU dispatch sites.

title: Per-block apply_wd: deep half only
mechanism: In CPU model.rs and GPU build_grad_ops, set apply_wd=true only for blocks with li >= n_layer/2; shallow blocks weight matrices skip WD

title: Position embedding init at 0.5x baseline magnitude
mechanism: w_pos init uniform[-0.5*scale, +0.5*scale] where scale = 0.02*sqrt(3). Half the baseline magnitude.

title: Composite: fixup + WSD + pos-embed at 1/2 magnitude
mechanism: w_o = w_proj = 0 (fixup) AND w_pos init at 0.5x baseline magnitude AND WSD schedule (warmup -> stable -> linear tail 20% decay)
reason: transformer_smoke::cpu_transformer_argmax_sanity failed - model predicted 0 instead of 2 on identity copy task. Different failure mode than quarter-pos (iter 13); smoke gate non-monotonic in pos magnitude.

title: Token embedding init at 0.5x baseline magnitude
mechanism: w_tok init uniform[-0.5*scale, +0.5*scale] where scale = 0.02*sqrt(3). Tied LM head sees half-magnitude initial logits.

title: Composite: fixup + WSD + w_tok at 1/2 magnitude
mechanism: w_o = w_proj = 0 (fixup) AND w_tok init at 0.5x baseline magnitude AND WSD schedule. Tied LM head sees half-magnitude initial logits.

title: Composite: w_tok and w_pos both at 0.5x init magnitude
mechanism: Both w_tok and w_pos init uniform[-0.5*scale, +0.5*scale]; embed_forward halved.
notes: Slightly super-additive vs pos-half+tok-half standalones (predicted -0.044, actual -0.053). Distinct mechanisms.

notes: Mildly sub-additive: predicted -0.102, observed -0.094 (+0.008 overlap). First sub-additive composite — WSD and embed-half share weak overlap in mechanism.

title: Zero-init w_o (MHA output) only

title: Composite: fixup-mha-only (w_o = 0) + WSD schedule
mechanism: Zero-init w_o (MHA output) only; FFN w_proj keeps baseline GPT-3 scaling. WSD schedule (warmup-stable-decay over tail 20%).
notes: NEW BANK-BEST. Mildly sub-additive (predicted -0.381, observed -0.376). +0.067 over prior best combo-fixup-wsd.

title: Zero-init w_proj (FFN output) only
mechanism: w_proj = LinearProj::new_scaled(d_ff, d_model, 0.0, rng); w_o keeps GPT-3 scaling. FFN sublayer = 0 at init, MHA non-zero.
notes: Confirms iter 22 interpretation: FFN-side zero-init is harmful by +0.025 standalone. fixup-mha-only is the better single-tensor change vs fixup-full.

title: Composite: fixup-mha-only (w_o=0) + both embed halves
mechanism: Zero-init w_o; w_tok and w_pos both at 0.5x baseline magnitude. FFN w_proj keeps baseline.

title: Zero-init w_o in shallow blocks (0..n/2) only
mechanism: Post-process blocks in DecoderTransformer::new: zero mha.w_o.w for layer indices < n_layer/2; deeper blocks keep baseline.
reason: transformer_smoke::cpu_transformer_converges_on_copy_task failed at 13% relative drop in 200 steps (threshold 30%). Asymmetric init converges slower than either uniform zero (iter 22 passed) or baseline.

title: Additive gradient noise on d_logits (scale 0.005)
mechanism: cross_entropy_with_grad body: after standard d_logits, add per-element noise sampled from deterministic LCG seeded by (target XOR logits[0]). Scale 0.005 = 0.5% of target signal magnitude.
notes: Noise absorbed by AdamW m2; no effect at 1-epoch undertrained byte-LM scale.

note: 3-seed validation of fixup-mha-only after merge to main. All three seeds give delta within +-0.01 of mean -0.335. Effect is real and seed-robust; original iter22 was not a lucky seed. Baseline single-seed (seed 42); experiment-vs-baseline comparison mixes seed-noise into measurement but effect (~-0.33) dwarfs noise floor (~0.01). Code: src/transformer/attention.rs w_o = LinearProj::new_scaled(d,d,0.0,rng).

title: Halve FFN w_fc init magnitude
mechanism: FfnWeights::new w_fc uses LinearProj::new_scaled(.,.,0.5,.) instead of plain Xavier; halves init std of FFN expansion projection.
notes: Major regression. Anti-stacks with post-merge baseline's built-in fixup-mha-only — same pattern as iters 19 and 25. New baseline is at the minimum-viable signal floor; further init-magnitude reduction in any sublayer branch hurts.

title: Square-root concave warmup curve
mechanism: cosine_warmup warmup branch: base_lr * sqrt((step+1)/warmup) instead of linear; concave rise reaches base_lr faster.
notes: Counter to hypothesis. Faster early-LR ramp hurts even with otherwise stable schedule. Suggests baseline's 200-step linear warmup is well-tuned for fixup-mha-only init and AdamW bias correction needs time to settle before exposing to base_lr.

title: Disable WD on attention + token-embed
mechanism: apply_wd=false for w_tok, w_q, w_k, w_v, w_o in both CPU step_adamw and GPU build_grad_ops; WD kept on w_fc, w_proj only.
notes: Near-zero effect. Per-step WD shrinkage at lambda=0.1,lr=6e-4 is ~0.006%, too small to matter in 641 steps. Consistent with embed-no-wd (Δ=+0.001): WD-targeting in this regime is effectively a no-op. Optimizer-area triangulation: small AdamW config tweaks don't move the needle on the new baseline.

title: Noam-style inverse-sqrt LR decay
mechanism: cosine_warmup post-warmup branch: base_lr * sqrt(warmup/step); power-law decay, never reaches min_lr.
notes: Small improvement below threshold. Same mechanism as wsd-tail20-linear (which won -0.049 on OLD baseline) — keep LR near base_lr longer. Win shrinks dramatically on new baseline; the fixup-mha-only init already extracts more value per step, so additional high-LR steps add less marginal value.

title: AdamW beta2 0.95 -> 0.98
mechanism: AdamWConfig::default beta2 changed 0.95 to 0.98; longer m2 averaging window (~50 vs ~20 effective steps).
notes: Mild improvement (-0.010) just below win threshold. Same direction & magnitude as inverse-sqrt-decay (-0.007) — both increase smoothness of step magnitudes. Suggests 'smoother dynamics' family caps around -0.01 individually; composing might super-add. Worth a follow-up composite (decay × beta2) iteration.

title: Composite: inverse-sqrt decay + beta2 0.98
mechanism: schedule.rs post-warmup = base*sqrt(warmup/step); optimizer beta2 0.95->0.98. Stacks 'smooth schedule' and 'smooth optimizer' independent-axis interventions.
notes: Closest miss in new-baseline era. Component sum: -0.017 (-0.007 inverse-sqrt + -0.010 beta2). Composite: -0.019. Super-additive by 0.002 — minor cross-talk reduction. Just below -0.020 win threshold. Confirms 'smoother dynamics' family caps around -0.02 even when stacked. To cross the threshold on new baseline, need a NEW mechanism axis (architectural, attention temperature, norm placement, etc) — schedule/optimizer/init are now ~maxed out.

title: Vaswani sinusoidal init for w_pos
mechanism: w_pos[pos,2i]=sin(pos/10000^(2i/d)), w_pos[pos,2i+1]=cos(...). 12 LoC pure CPU init change, GPU inherits via from_cpu.
reason: cpu_transformer_argmax_sanity failed; sinusoidal init magnitude ~1 vs old random ~0.035 (28x larger) overwhelms token signal in small-dim test
notes: Math correct, GPU parity ok. Magnitude imbalance is the bug — Vaswani paper scales w_tok by sqrt(d_model) to compensate, Aurora doesn't. Follow-up: scaled sinusoidal (* ~0.05) to preserve structure without imbalance.

title: Magnitude-matched sinusoidal pos init
mechanism: EmbedWeights::new w_pos = 0.03 * Vaswani PE (sin/cos at varying frequencies); 11 LoC CPU init, GPU inherits via from_cpu.
notes: Large regression. Sinusoidal prior pins model into a deterministic positional subspace it must unlearn before extracting LM-useful position info. Random uniform's higher entropy gives AdamW freedom to discover task-aligned representations. Negative result of value: structural init is HARMFUL when the task's optimal pos representations don't match the prior. Pos embedding has been touched 5 times now (3 wins old-baseline-era + 1 loss WD + 1 broken_impl + this); the magnitude axis was favorable, the pattern axis is unfavorable.

title: AdamW beta1 0.9 -> 0.95
mechanism: AdamWConfig::default beta1 0.9 to 0.95; smoother first-moment momentum (~20-step effective window vs ~10).
reason: cpu_transformer_argmax_sanity failed; β1=0.95 + smoke's aggressive lr=3e-2 → momentum too slow to reach identity-prediction in 100 steps
notes: Test interaction problem, not a math issue. Full screening at lr=6e-4 would likely behave fine, but spec gates on smoke. β1=0.92 or 0.93 might be the boundary that passes smoke while still smoothing momentum somewhat. Worth a follow-up to probe.

title: AdamW beta1 0.9 -> 0.92
mechanism: AdamWConfig::default beta1 0.9 to 0.92; ~12 step m1 effective window (vs 10).
notes: Counter to hypothesis. β1 smoothing hurts (unlike β2 smoothing). Asymmetry: β2 (m2 magnitude smoothing in denominator) wants MORE averaging; β1 (m1 direction smoothing in numerator) wants LESS. Direction estimate at byte-LM batch=16 has real signal — smoothing dilutes course corrections. Validates β1=0.9 as right setting; excludes β1>0.9 from smooth-dynamics composites.

title: Final LN gamma init 0.5
mechanism: DecoderTransformer::new override final_ln.gamma to 0.5; halves logit magnitudes AND halves grad flow through stack.
notes: Major regression. γ=0.5 halves d_x_pre_LN gradient flowing into the stack via layer_norm_backward's γ-scaling. Entire model trains at half-effective-LR until γ recovers. First norm-placement entry; useful negative result: γ init perturbations are NOT a no-cost knob, the backward gradient-scaling effect dominates. Excludes γ perturbations from future norm-placement composites.

title: Zero-init w_k in MHA (uniform attention at init)
mechanism: MhaWeights::new w_k=new_scaled(0.0); softmax(0)=uniform; with baseline w_o=0 gives MHA_out=0 at init. 1-step deadlock breaks via w_o updating first.
notes: Neutral within noise. w_o=0 alone is the active ingredient of fixup-mha-only's win; layering w_k=0 doesn't compound. Useful for future iters: don't keep zero-init-stacking inside MHA — explore other mechanism axes (FFN-side, embedding, schedule).

title: AdamW eps inside sqrt placement
mechanism: step = lr*m1_hat / sqrt(m2_hat + eps²) instead of / (sqrt(m2_hat) + eps). 2 LoC (CPU + GPU WGSL).
notes: Tiny improvement, below threshold. Expected — eps placement is equivalent for m2_hat >> eps² (always after step 1). Joins smooth-dynamics family. Eps axis now mapped. Runtime 970s (vs 617 typical) suggests GPU contention noise; effect is in noise floor.

title: Zero-init w_tok (token embedding)
mechanism: EmbedWeights::new w_tok = vec![0.0]; all tokens identical at init, w_tok learns via tied LM head + embed-backward pathways.
notes: Catastrophic regression. Asymmetric with pos-embed-zero (which won on old baseline). Token identity is task-critical for byte-LM and cannot be recovered from zero-init within 641 steps. Tied LM head amplifies recovery cost. Confirms 'head-start hurts' pattern is task-conditional: applies when random init is spurious, backfires when init carries genuine signal.

title: Freeze all LN β params at 0 (implicit RMSNorm)
mechanism: CPU: skip adamw_apply for ln1.beta, ln2.beta, final_ln.beta. GPU: skip dispatch_with_bind for beta ops (indices 3, 5, 7, 11, ...). 13 groups never updated.
notes: Neutral within noise. LayerNorm β is genuinely redundant under tied LM head — γ, w_tok, biases-in-other-params fully compensate. Bonus: 5% faster runtime (585s vs ~617s). Confirms RMSNorm validity for this architecture. β doesn't add expressivity for byte-LM. Free perf, no quality cost.

title: Internal 2x grad clip threshold
mechanism: CPU+GPU clip_grads internally use max_norm*2 instead of max_norm. Doubles the effective gradient norm cap while keeping cli_args unchanged.
notes: Moderate regression. The 1.0 grad_clip threshold IS well-tuned — letting 2x larger gradients through destabilizes training. Confirms conservative clip is calibrated, not over-aggressive. Excludes 'loosen clip' from future composites.

title: Per-block LR multiplier 1.5->0.5 (shallow→deep)
mechanism: step_adamw with per-block lr_mult = 1.5 - li/(n_layer-1). Block 0 = 1.5x, block 5 = 0.5x. Non-block params (w_tok, w_pos, final_ln) unchanged. CPU+GPU both modified.
notes: Mild regression. Conventional 'deep needs more LR or equal' wins over counter-intuitive 'shallow needs more LR'. Inverse direction (per-block-lr-linear-up, deep > shallow) would be a natural follow-up — expected to be sub-threshold win at most based on this evidence.

title: Per-block LR multiplier 0.5->1.5 (shallow→deep)
mechanism: step_adamw with per-block lr_mult = 0.5 + li/(n_layer-1). Block 0 = 0.5x, block 5 = 1.5x. CPU+GPU.
notes: -0.013 improvement, below threshold. Inverse of iter 44 (per-block-lr-linear-down +0.018). Asymmetry ~0.032 BPB confirms deep blocks benefit from larger LR. Joins smoother-dynamics family. THIRD independent mechanism axis for possible 3-way composite (β2 × decay × per-block-up). All ~-0.01 individually; combo might cross threshold.

title: 3-way composite: inverse-sqrt + β2=0.98 + per-block-lr-up

notes: WIN. First win on new post-merge baseline this session. Linear sum of components -0.031 (-0.007 + -0.010 + -0.014); actual -0.0316. Perfect linear additivity — three mechanisms independent across schedule × optimizer × depth-cond-reg. No GPU shader changes, no new params, no checkpoint bump. Worth multi-seed validation before merge.

title: Per-block LR 0.3x→1.7x (wider spread)
mechanism: step_adamw per-block lr_mult = 0.3 + 1.4*li/(n_layer-1). Block 0 = 0.3x, block 5 = 1.7x. CPU+GPU.

Natural follow-ups: wider spread still, OR substitute into iter 46 composite for combo-decay-beta2-blocklr-spread-wide (expected -0.038).

title: 3-way composite, wider block-LR spread
mechanism: schedule post-warmup base*sqrt(warmup/step); optimizer beta2=0.98; per-block lr_mult 0.3+1.4*li/(n_layer-1). CPU+GPU.
notes: WIN. Strongest composite yet on new baseline. Linear sum -0.0376; actual -0.0406 → super-add +0.003. Triangulation: iter 33 (2-way) +0.002, iter 46 (3-way narrow) linear, iter 48 (3-way wide) +0.003. Schedule × optimizer × depth-cond axes show genuine independence with mild beneficial interaction. Bank-best for new baseline session.

title: Per-block LR 0.2x→1.8x extreme spread
mechanism: step_adamw per-block lr_mult = 0.2 + 1.6*li/(n_layer-1). Block 0 = 0.2x, block 5 = 1.8x. CPU+GPU.

title: 3-way composite extreme block-LR [0.2, 1.8]

title: Per-block LR 0.1x→1.9x (overshoot)
mechanism: step_adamw per-block lr_mult = 0.1 + 1.8*li/(n_layer-1). Block 0=0.1x, block 5=1.9x. CPU+GPU.

title: Quadratic depth-LR shape (same endpoints as iter 49)
mechanism: step_adamw lr_mult = 0.536 + 1.264·frac² where frac=li/(n_layer-1). Quadratic profile, mean=1.0, endpoints (0.536, 1.8). CPU+GPU.

title: 4-way: iter 50 + freeze-LN-betas

notes: Both components passed smoke individually. Joint reduction of shallow-block optimization capacity is below smoke convergence threshold. Useful: 'neutral solo' + 'winning composite' isn't always safe at extreme block-LR ratios.

title: Per-block WD multiplier 0.5x→1.5x
mechanism: step_adamw per-block wd_mult = 0.5 + li/(n_layer-1). Block 0=0.5x WD, block 5=1.5x WD. Mean=1.0. CPU+GPU.
notes: Neutral. WD step magnitude (lr·wd·|param| ~ 1.2e-6) is too small for per-block scaling to matter. Per-block-LR is the active mechanism in depth-cond-reg, NOT per-block-WD. Combined with iter 30 (wd-attention-off neutral), WD-targeting axis is exhausted.

title: Step-function per-block LR (0.5x→1.5x at boundary)
mechanism: step_adamw lr_mult = if li<n_layer/2 {0.5} else {1.5}. Discrete tier at block n_layer/2 boundary. CPU+GPU.
notes: Moderate regression. Same endpoints/mean as linear [0.5, 1.5] (-0.014 win). 0.064 BPB delta between shapes. Discontinuous 3x jump between blocks 2-3 disrupts smooth feature gradation. Depth-LR shape MUST be smooth/continuous; linear is right shape. Combined with iter 52 (quadratic neutral): only linear works in this family.

title: Quadratic warmup curve (convex)
mechanism: cosine_warmup warmup branch: base_lr * frac² (convex shape, slower than linear early).
notes: Neutral. Warmup curve axis mapped: sqrt=+0.149, linear=0, quadratic=+0.002. Linear is well-tuned; both faster (sqrt) and slower (quadratic) hurt or don't help. 200-step linear ramp is the right shape for this AdamW config.

title: AdamW without bias correction
mechanism: adamw_apply skip bc1, bc2 division. m1_hat=m1, m2_hat=m2 directly. CPU+GPU.
reason: cpu_transformer_converges_on_copy_task failed; without bc, initial steps tiny (~0.22×) and smoke's lr=3e-2 drives loss UP before momentum accumulates
notes: Bias correction is essential for early-step stability at high LR. Cannot be removed safely. Useful for any future 'warmup-free' attempts.

title: WSD-tail20 schedule on new baseline
mechanism: schedule.rs post-warmup: flat at base_lr for 80% of remaining, linear decay to min_lr in last 20%. Same WSD body as iter 2 worktree but rebuilt on post-merge HEAD.

title: 3-way composite: WSD-tail20 + β2=0.98 + per-block-lr [0.2,1.8]
mechanism: schedule.rs WSD-tail20 (flat 80% + linear decay 20%); optimizer beta2=0.98; per-block lr_mult 0.2+1.6*li/(n_layer-1). CPU+GPU.

Iter 50's composite with schedule upgraded from inverse-sqrt-decay (-0.007) to WSD-tail20 (-0.044): lifted -0.0489 → -0.0825 (+69%). Schedule axis was the bottleneck. Cumulative from old baseline 2.7188 → 2.304 = -0.414 BPB. Bank-best for new baseline; strong merge candidate.

title: WSD schedule with 10% decay tail
mechanism: schedule.rs WSD body with 0.1 decay fraction (flat base_lr 90%, linear decay 10%).
notes: WIN but weaker than wsd-tail20 (-0.044). Tail-fraction: tail10=-0.033, tail20=-0.044. 10% tail too short — sacrifices end-of-training annealing. 20% is better; 'stay-high-longer' theme has a limit. wsd-tail20 remains the schedule component for composites. Kept for sweep completeness but superseded.

title: WSD schedule with 30% decay tail
mechanism: schedule.rs WSD body with 0.3 decay fraction (flat base_lr 70%, linear decay 30%).
notes: WIN. Marginally better than wsd-tail20 (-0.0437) — within noise. Tail sweep: tail10=-0.033, tail20=-0.044, tail30=-0.045. Broad optimum 20-30%; tail20/tail30 statistically tied. Schedule axis fully characterized: WSD with 20-30% tail. Composite (iter 59) uses tail20 — substituting tail30 negligible (~0.001).

title: 1.5x LR for token+positional embeddings
mechanism: step_adamw: w_tok, w_pos use config.lr*1.5; blocks unchanged. CPU+GPU (ops 0,1).
reason: cpu_transformer_argmax_sanity failed; 1.5x embed LR × smoke's lr=3e-2 = 4.5e-2 effective destabilizes 100-step identity test
notes: Same pattern as adam-beta1-095: fine at training lr=6e-4 but breaks smoke's high-LR regime. Follow-up: milder 1.2x embed LR might pass smoke.

title: 1.2x LR for token+positional embeddings
mechanism: step_adamw: w_tok, w_pos use config.lr*1.2; blocks + final_ln unchanged. CPU+GPU (ops 0,1).
notes: WIN. Embedding-group LR boost is a real mechanism. NEW independent axis — scales w_tok/w_pos, orthogonal to per-block-lr (transformer blocks). 1.5x broke smoke (iter 62); 1.2x safe. Predicted 4-way composite with iter 59 bank-best: linear sum -0.106. High-priority follow-up.

title: 4-way: WSD + β2 + per-block-lr + embed-lr 1.2x
mechanism: WSD-tail20 schedule; beta2=0.98; per-block lr 0.2+1.6*li/(n_layer-1); embed (w_tok,w_pos) lr 1.2x. CPU+GPU.
reason: cpu_transformer_converges_on_copy_task failed; 24.4% drop in 600 steps (need 30%). 4-way LR-modulation stack disrupts smoke copy-task convergence
notes: All 4 components + the 3-way subset (iter 59) pass smoke; the 4-way doesn't. Composite-interference pattern (cf iter 53). per-block-lr block-0 at 0.2x plus embed boost 1.2x = per-group LR imbalance too large for smoke. iter 59 (-0.0825) remains bank-best mergeable. Follow-up: milder embed-lr 1.1x might pass.

title: 4-way: WSD + β2 + per-block-lr + embed-lr 1.1x
mechanism: WSD-tail20 schedule; beta2=0.98; per-block lr 0.2+1.6*li/(n_layer-1); embed (w_tok,w_pos) lr 1.1x. CPU+GPU.
notes: WIN. NEW BANK-BEST. Beats 3-way iter 59 (-0.0825) by ~0.004. Milder embed-lr 1.1x cleared smoke (1.2x broke it iter 64). Linear prediction ~-0.103; actual -0.087 → SUB-additive by 0.016. embed-LR overlaps mechanistically with per-block-LR (both per-group AdamW step modulation) → diminishing returns. Cumulative old baseline 2.7188 → 2.300 = -0.419 BPB. iter 59 simpler for near-same result; both merge candidates.

title: FFN activation GELU → SiLU
mechanism: linalg.rs gelu/gelu_backward bodies + GPU gelu.rs WGSL changed to SiLU = x*sigmoid(x).
notes: Mild regression. SiLU underperforms GELU by ~0.024 on byte-LM 1-epoch. GELU curvature better-tuned for baseline init (Xavier FFN + GPT-3 residual scaling implicitly calibrated for GELU). Activation-function axis: GELU is the right choice; swapping costs without re-tuning init.

title: AdamW beta2 0.95 -> 0.99
mechanism: AdamWConfig::default beta2 0.99; ~100-step m2 averaging window.
notes: -0.010, below threshold. Identical to β2=0.98 (-0.010003). β2 sweep: 0.95=0, 0.98=-0.010, 0.99=-0.010 — broad plateau optimum 0.98-0.99. Composite uses 0.98; 0.99 equivalent. β2 axis fully characterized.

title: w_tok-only LR boost 1.2x
mechanism: step_adamw: only w_tok uses lr*1.2, w_pos at base. CPU+GPU op 0 only.
reason: smoke argmax sanity + copy-task convergence failed; w_tok-only boost creates w_tok/w_pos LR imbalance that destabilizes the tiny smoke model
notes: Surprising: embed-lr-1p2x (both, iter 63) passed smoke; w_tok-only subset fails. The embedding-LR mechanism needs w_tok and w_pos scaled TOGETHER — they must stay balanced. embed-LR gain is a joint property of the embedding group, not decomposable to w_tok alone.

title: 3-way: WSD + β2 + embed-lr 1.2x
mechanism: WSD-tail20 schedule; beta2=0.98; embed (w_tok,w_pos) lr 1.2x. No per-block-lr. CPU+GPU.
notes: WIN, not bank-best. Diagnostic: 3-way with embed-lr as 3rd axis (-0.0735) vs iter 59 with per-block-lr (-0.0825) — per-block-LR composes ~0.009 better. Linear sum -0.081, actual -0.0735, sub-additive 0.0075. embed-LR consistently sub-additive in composites. Bank-best remains iter 65 (4-way -0.0868) / iter 59 (3-way -0.0825).

title: 4-way: WSD-tail30 + β2 + per-block-lr + embed-lr 1.1x
mechanism: WSD-tail30 schedule; beta2=0.98; per-block lr 0.2+1.6*li/(n_layer-1); embed lr 1.1x. CPU+GPU.
notes: WIN. NEW BANK-BEST. Beats iter 65 (same recipe, tail20) by 0.0026 — tail30 solo edge transferred to composite. val_bpb 2.297559. Cumulative old baseline 2.7188 → 2.298 = -0.421 BPB. Consolidated best recipe; strong merge candidate. No GPU shader changes, no new params.

title: WSD-tail30 decaying to 0 instead of min_lr
mechanism: schedule.rs WSD tail: base_lr*(1-decay_progress) → ends at 0, not min_lr.
notes: WIN but weaker than wsd-tail30 with min_lr floor (iter 61, -0.045) by ~0.003. The min_lr=6e-5 floor is mildly beneficial — tiny non-zero final LR beats freezing at 0. Decay-target axis: decay-to-min_lr > decay-to-0. Bank-best composite correctly uses min_lr floor.

note: Post-merge-baseline research session (iters 28-71, baseline 2.386948) concluded after 44 iterations: 15 wins, ~22 losses, 6 broken_impl. Bank-best: combo-4way-wsd30 (iter 70) Δ=-0.089389 (val_bpb 2.297559) — WSD-tail30 + AdamW β2=0.98 + per-block-lr linear [0.2x,1.8x] + embed-lr 1.1x; 36 LoC, no GPU shader changes, no new params. Cumulative from old SNN-era baseline 2.718824 → 2.2976 = -0.421 BPB. Feasible cheap mechanism space (schedule, optimizer hyperparams, per-block-LR, embed-LR, init, norm-placement, activation, loss-aux, grad-clip) is comprehensively mapped. Remaining untried frontier — attention-mechanism changes (QK-norm, logit soft-cap, attention-temperature) — requires GPU tiled-MHA forward+backward WGSL kernel restructuring that exceeds the <30min per-iteration envelope and carries high gpu_parity-failure risk. Loop paused here pending either (a) multi-seed validation + merge of combo-4way-wsd30, or (b) a dedicated larger effort for the GPU attention-kernel frontier. 12 KEEP worktrees preserved for validation.

3-seed unpaired validation (precedent: validation-fixup-mha-only-multiseed). Screening delta -0.089389 (seed 42) does NOT reproduce. Per-seed deltas vs fixed seed-42 baseline: -0.089389/-0.006501/-0.065033; seed 1337 lands within the noise floor. mean -0.053641, pop std 0.034784, effect/std ~1.5x (fixup was ~56x). Experiment val_bpb spread 0.083 across seeds. Cross-seed noise on a 1-epoch screening delta is ~0.035 -- 4-7x the README assumed 0.005-0.01 and far above the -0.02 win threshold. combo-4way-wsd30 is at best a soft win (~-0.05 expected) but NOT seed-robust; -0.089 was an upward-biased best-of-~70 single-seed draws (winner curse). gpu_parity 16/16 pass; GPU per-block-LR indexing statically verified vs CPU. Unpaired caveat: 1337/2024 deltas borrow the seed-42 baseline. Recommendation: do not merge as -0.089; sub--0.05 wins in the post-merge bank need the same multi-seed scrutiny.

title: Muon (NS5 quintic) for 2D matrix params + AdamW for embed/LN, CPU f32
mechanism: Per-block w_q/w_k/w_v/w_o/w_fc/w_proj go through SGD-momentum (β=0.95, Nesterov) → Newton-Schulz5 orthogonalization (Frobenius-bounded init, quintic (3.4445,-4.7750,2.0315), 5 iter) → spectral aspect scaling sqrt(max/min); update applied with lr=0.02. Embeddings (w_tok, w_pos), LayerNorm γ/β stay on AdamW (lr=6e-4). Grad clip applied only to AdamW slice (NS already bounds Muon update).
notes: 2-seed CPU screening on tiny_600k (d=128 L=4 h=4 dff=512 bs=16 ep=1 warmup=20). Per-seed delta vs AdamW baseline: s42=+0.0043, s1337=-0.0015, mean=+0.0014 (well below noise floor 0.035). Wall-clock cost 1.7x AdamW (150s→260s avg) due to per-matrix NS5 = 5*(2 m*m + 1 m^2*n) f32 matmuls in serial. LR ablation: muon-lr=0.05 worse than 0.02 (3.131 vs 3.126 at seed 42). NOT a win at this scale. Confounders for negative result: (a) model too small (~1M params, paper wins are 10M+), (b) f32 not bf16, (c) only 1 epoch on 586KB corpus. Definitive evaluation needs overnight enwik8_10m d=384 L=6 multi-seed. GPU port (Sprint 63) only justified if overnight shows positive signal. Implementation: src/optimizer.rs (newton_schulz5, muon_apply, MuonScratch), src/transformer/model.rs (MuonState, step_muon_hybrid, clip_grads_adamw_subset), examples/aurora_train.rs (--optimizer --muon-lr --muon-momentum flags), tests/muon.rs (9 tests, all pass).

title: Muon GPU port — Newton-Schulz5 + momentum + apply via wgpu/WGSL
mechanism: 6 new WGSL kernels (muon_momentum, muon_frob_inv, muon_load_store transpose-aware, muon_combine_b, muon_step_x, muon_apply) + reuse of GemmKernel/GemmTransposeBKernel for NS5 matmul stages. Per-matrix dispatch: momentum → frob reduce → 1/sqrt finalize → scale → load → 5×(XX^T, A@A, B=bA+cA_sq, B@X, X=aX+BX) → store → apply. Shared scratch (sized for max matrix), per-matrix cached bind groups for momentum + apply, shared bind groups for everything else.
notes: PARITY ACHIEVED. GPU val_bpb 3.125864 matches CPU val_bpb 3.125864 to 4 decimals on tiny_600k d=128 L=4 ep=1 warmup=20 seed=42. GPU parity tests pass at 5e-2 tolerance (1-step CPU↔GPU drift well inside bound). Wall-clock: GPU AdamW 23s vs GPU Muon 30s (30% Muon overhead, vs 70% on CPU). CPU baselines: AdamW 150s, Muon 256s. Overall GPU speedup: 8.5x for Muon, 6.5x for AdamW. Overnight 3-seed × 2-optim × nano × 4-ep estimate: ~12h GPU vs ~150h+ CPU — now feasible in a single overnight. Implementation: src/gpu/muon.rs (~530 LOC, 6 kernels), src/gpu/transformer.rs (+ BlockMuonMoments, MuonScratchGpu, MuonOps, MuonSharedOps, step_muon_hybrid, clip_grads_adamw_subset, alloc_muon_scratch, build_muon_shared_ops, build_muon_ops), tests/gpu_parity.rs (+2 tests: muon_hybrid_step_matches_cpu, gpu_muon_hybrid_drops_loss_on_overfit). 54/54 tests green. Train loop refusal removed — --gpu --optimizer muon now works.
